title: Agnus Dei (Johannes Okeghem, Missa Cuiusvis toni (on E))
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Missa Cuiusvis toni (on E), Agnus Dei. 4 voices (Discantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
